crisis.title: Help For Adoptive Families In Crisis
crisis.description: We are a Parents In Training Inc. program. We have developed an Adoption Wraparound Service with a love-based unique methodology. This is an intense trauma-responsive educational program for adoptive parents on how to better understand and care for their adopted child.
crisis.entityDefinition: LEAF Wraparound (Love-Based Education for Adoptive Families) is a love-based, trauma-responsive adoption wraparound program of Parents in Training Inc. that supports adoptive families across 20+ counties in Northern and Central California.
crisis.noCostBefore: We help families who have adopted children under 18 in California receiving benefits through the Adoption Assistance Program.
crisis.noCostBold: There is no out-of-pocket cost to families.
crisis.quote: When a family is supported, a child can heal.

expertise.quoteText: Reducing stress and bringing peace back to your home.
expertise.description: The adoption journey is beautiful, but it can bring complex challenges. Wraparound is a team-based approach that supports adoptive families exactly where they are. We do whatever it takes to help your child heal.
expertise.feature1Text: We don't hand you a generic manual. Your family's voice, culture, and specific goals are the foundation of your care plan.
expertise.feature2Text: Healing doesn't come from focusing on problems. We use your family's profound resilience to overcome hurdles.
expertise.feature3Text: You don't have to navigate post-adoption life alone. We coordinate with schools, therapists, and your network.

qualifies.title: We're here for families like yours
qualifies.intro: If any of this feels familiar, LEAF was built for your family. No forms to pass, no hoops to jump through.
qualifies.point1: You're raising a child you adopted here in California
qualifies.point3: You adopted through the Adoption Assistance Program (AAP)
qualifies.point4: Things feel hard right now, and the usual help hasn't been enough
qualifies.reassurance: Always free for AAP families. No referral needed.
qualifies.ctaSecondary: Or see how our program works

services.title: Our Services
services.goalTitle: To reduce stress on the adoptive parents.
services.goalText: We want to educate, help and empower parents to understand what it takes to create a long-term healing environment for their children. The main pillars of our program are love and education.
services.quote: "Our staff is highly qualified in trauma-responsive treatment approaches with children and their families, working under direct supervision of Bryan Post to Jeanette Yoffe, LCSW."

cta.description: Join our wraparound program and get the support your family needs to thrive.
